--- Completion.md ---
Page link completion
SilverBullet provides context-aware autocomplete to help you write faster. Completions are triggered automatically or via keyboard shortcuts as you type.

--- Event.md ---
Subscribing to events | Dispatching events
You can dispatch your own custom events:

```lua
event.dispatch("my-custom-event", {message = "Hello!"})
```

Other scripts can then listen for `my-custom-event`.

--- Completion.md ---
Page link completion | Custom completions
You can extend the completion system by subscribing to the `editor:complete` event via [[Space Lua]]. Your handler receives the current cursor context and can return additional completion items.

See also: [[API/event]]

--- View.md ---
Widgets and views | Custom views
In your own space, put the following definition in a `space-lua` block, then run `System: Reload`. Register a view with `view.define` to give it a name, a command, and a dock. This example adds a task-list modal:
```lua
view.define {
  name = "tasks",
  title = "Open tasks",
  command = "Navigate: Open Tasks",
  dock = "modal",
  source = function()
    return query [[
      from t = index.tasks()
      where not t.done
      order by t.page
    ]]
  end,
  presentation = {
    mode = "list",
    row = {
      primary = "name",
      description = "page"
    }
  },
  onSelect = function(task)
    editor.navigate(task.ref)
  end,
}
```

In this flat row definition, `name`, `source` and `onSelect` are required. `command` registers a [[Command]] that opens the view, and `key`/`mac` define a key binding for it. Open one from anywhere Lua runs with `view.open("tasks")`.

--- Event.md ---
Subscribing to events | Built-in events > Interaction events
* `page:click`: User clicked a location on the page
* `editor:complete`: Editor completion triggered — return completion results to extend [[Completion]]
* `slash:complete`: Slash completion triggered — return completion results
* `editor:lint`: Lint request — return errors to show in the editor
